B12_00.process: Embryonic development of the inner ear from surface ectoderm.
B12_00.disease: Congenital deafness, balance defects, and syndromic ciliopathies with retinal and renal disease.
B12_00.tissue: Developing inner ear epithelium and ectoderm.

B12_01.process: Formation of the endoderm germ layer during early embryonic development.
B12_01.tissue: Early embryonic cells giving rise to gut, liver, pancreas and lung.

B12_02.process: Timing and regularity of embryonic body segmentation into somites.
B12_02.disease: Congenital vertebral malformations such as spondylocostal dysostosis.

B12_03.process: Specification of heart progenitor cells during embryonic heart development.
B12_03.disease: Congenital heart disease, including tetralogy of Fallot and truncus arteriosus.
B12_03.tissue: Embryonic cardiac mesoderm, right ventricle and outflow tract.

B12_04.disease: Renal agenesis, hypoplasia, duplex kidneys and vesicoureteric reflux.
B12_04.tissue: Wolffian duct and metanephric mesenchyme of the developing kidney.

B12_05.process: Patterning of embryonic somites into front and back halves.
B12_05.disease: Congenital spine malformations and fused vertebrae.

B12_06.process: Hollowing of solid cell cords to form tubes and ducts.
B12_06.disease: Hypohidrotic ectodermal dysplasia and blocked secretory ducts.
B12_06.tissue: Sweat, salivary and mammary gland ducts and airways.

B12_07.process: Growth factor signalling promoting formation of epithelial and vascular tubes.
B12_07.disease: Renal agenesis, branchio-oto-renal syndrome, and defective vascular tube formation.
B12_07.tissue: Developing kidney, blood vessels, airways and glands.

B12_08.process: Formation of the sperm acrosome during sperm maturation.
B12_08.tissue: Developing sperm cells in the testis.

B12_09.process: Myelin formation by glial cells in the central nervous system.
B12_09.disease: Leukodystrophies and demyelinating diseases such as multiple sclerosis.
B12_09.tissue: Oligodendrocytes and axons in brain and spinal cord.

B12_10.process: Formation of the mesoderm germ layer during gastrulation.
B12_10.disease: Embryonic axis defects and absent cardiac progenitors.
B12_10.tissue: Early embryonic epiblast and primitive streak.

B12_11.process: Folding of the neural plate during early nervous system development.
B12_11.disease: Neural tube defects such as spina bifida and anencephaly.
B12_11.tissue: Embryonic neural plate and surface ectoderm.

B12_12.process: Early specification of endoderm cell fate in the embryo.
B12_12.tissue: Early embryonic cells and stem cells forming gut, liver, pancreas, lung.

B12_13.process: Assembly of the contractile apparatus in heart muscle cells.

B12_14.process: Embryonic formation of the trachea from the foregut.
B12_14.disease: Tracheoesophageal fistula, esophageal atresia, tracheal agenesis and tracheomalacia.
B12_14.tissue: Embryonic foregut, trachea and surrounding mesenchyme.

B12_15.process: Giving each embryonic somite its segment identity.
B12_15.disease: Congenital vertebral and rib segmentation defects.

B12_16.process: Assembly of the contractile apparatus in skeletal muscle fibres.
B12_16.disease: Nemaline myopathy and congenital muscle weakness.

B12_17.process: Tissue-to-tissue signalling that induces embryonic organ formation.
B12_17.disease: Organ agenesis, hypoplasia and congenital malformations.
B12_17.tissue: Embryonic epithelium and mesenchyme of kidney, limb, lung, heart, gonad.

B12_18.process: Hormone-dependent branching development of the prostate gland.
B12_18.disease: Prostatic agenesis, benign prostatic hyperplasia and prostate cancer.

B12_19.process: Formation of the embryonic duct draining the primitive kidney.
B12_19.disease: Congenital kidney and urinary tract anomalies and renal-coloboma syndrome.
B12_19.tissue: Embryonic intermediate mesoderm, kidney and urinary tract.

B12_20.process: Lengthening of the embryonic body axis during segmentation.
B12_20.disease: Axial truncation and incomplete vertebrae and ribs.
B12_20.tissue: Embryonic tail bud and presomitic mesoderm.

B12_21.process: Formation of kidney tubules during embryonic kidney development.
B12_21.disease: Renal hypoplasia, dysplasia, agenesis and later chronic kidney disease.

B12_22.process: Proliferation of heart progenitor cells during embryonic heart development.
B12_22.disease: Congenital outflow tract malformations and right heart hypoplasia.

B12_23.process: Closure of epithelial folds into tubes, mainly the neural tube.
B12_23.disease: Neural tube defects such as spina bifida and anencephaly.
B12_23.tissue: Embryonic neuroepithelium, optic fissure and palate.

B12_24.process: Formation of paraxial mesoderm during gastrulation.
B12_24.tissue: Embryonic mesoderm forming somites, skeleton and muscle.

B12_25.process: Signals that promote assembly of the muscle contractile apparatus.
B12_25.tissue: Heart muscle cells and other muscle cells.

B12_26.process: Building junctions between myelin and axons for fast nerve conduction.
B12_26.disease: Congenital hypomyelinating neuropathy and nerve conduction slowing.
